title: AMLO CDD identity controls
desc: Token and Identity Registry must expose the hooks necessary to perform customer and beneficial owner due diligence before onboarding.

title: AMLO record keeping support
desc: Identity Registry Storage must be wired and emit lifecycle events so identity evidence can be retained for at least seven years.

title: Sanctions and Blacklist Screening
desc: Smart contracts must enforce sanctions compliance by reverting transfers to addresses flagged by blacklist logic.

allOf.desc: Transfer to a random address should revert if blacklist logic is enforced

title: Ongoing Monitoring via Modular Compliance
desc: Smart contracts must enable modular compliance checks to enforce transaction surveillance, including country restrictions and monthly transfer limits.

allOf.desc: Transfer from blocked country or over monthly limits should revert due to active monitoring module
